Ledger site actor_perception.c:4025 is wrong (prop->lighting, an actor field set from a constant at :4056). The real reader is structures/structure_render.c:622, which passes &material->lighting to draw_transparent_triangles, bound at :878 to rasterizer_environment_transparent_geometry_submit (rasterizer/rasterizer.c:1490 wrapper). That wrapper calls _rasterizer_environment_transparent_geometry_submit, whose only definition in the CE tree is rasterizer/xbox/rasterizer_xbox_environment.c:3075, which copies lighting (0x74 bytes) into the Xbox group at :3183. halo-ps2 has no implementation of that symbol or any structure_material/environment_vertex_compressed consumer, so the only reader is Xbox-only D3D code and the PS2 equivalent is not established in this tree.
